address: contrada Torre Catena 874, Polignano a Mare, 70044, Italy
bio: In the extraordinary setting of a 14th-century farmhouse with a park and centuries-old trees, located in the Puglian countryside behind Polignano, you'll find one of the region's top gastronomic destinations. The choice is between two tasting menus, with five or seven courses, where chef Michele Spadaro offers his modern and creative take on Puglian cuisine. With over a thousand wine labels and a table set among the bottles, you'll experience excellent service in a fairytale setting....
